Group Travel Guidance

From the ORA eTraining module "Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement" (lesson 3 of 8).
Group Travel Rules
There are times when a single faculty member or administrative employee may lead a group of students to a conference or event. In such cases, one travel request form may be submitted under the employee’s name, with an attached Attendees List (see below) of all student participants. Additional group travel guidelines are outlined below.
Complete the content above before moving on.
Group Travel Attendees List
Required Attendee List
A completed Attendee List is required for group travel requests. This document must be completed and submitted as supporting documentation for the travel authorization or reimbursement form.
No Reimbursements
Students that are on group travel are not able to submit a travel reimbursement for travel expenses. If you believe reimbursement will be necessary, please complete separate TL requests for each student on the trip.
Graduate Student Restriction
Graduate students cannot receive funding from the GSA (Graduate Student Association) for any travel covered by other funding.
Travel Advances
Faculty/Staff running a group travel can request travel advances for the student attendees. The check will be made out in the employee's name, and that employee will be responsible for disbursing advances to students that require it. Further information on travel advances can be found on the Comptroller's Travel Office page.
